_note: Hanifolk Carnival, from the global client's master tables (built by scripts/gen_carnival.cjs). 'quests' is keyed by this server's carnival quest id: the event, the folder (one per element), the difficulty score and the time limit. A clear scores difficultyScore + max(0, timeLimitMs - clear time ms) (the Chinese fork's rule). 'rewards' are the total-score rewards, paid once each when the sum of the best score of every folder reaches 'score'. Reward kinds: 0 item, 1 armament, 2 beads, 3 mana, 4 exp, 6 title.
